definitions.gloss: to resemble closely; to be very similar; to bear a close resemblance
definitions.explanation: To share many characteristics or features with something else, to the point where the two are hard to distinguish. Often used for abstract qualities, patterns, or tendencies rather than physical appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{似通|にかよ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The two people's opinions are very similar.

examples.japanese: ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{似通|にかよ}った⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{決|き}め{手|て}→決め手：13252_kimete⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: All the proposals have similar content, and none stands out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{似通|にかよ}った⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The cultures of both countries share many similarities, suggesting a long history of exchange.

notes:
{似通|にかよ}う is an intransitive godan verb. It is most commonly used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form to describe a state of resemblance.

ASPECT (ている):
{似通|にかよ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is the standard form, meaning "to be similar" or "to resemble each other."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{似通|にかよ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (A and B are very similar)
- {似通|にかよ}った + noun (similar [noun])

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {似通|にかよ}った⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (similar opinions)
- {似通|にかよ}った⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (similar tendencies)
- {似通|にかよ}った⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧ (similar characteristics)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {似通|にかよ}う: to resemble closely (emphasizes high degree of similarity)
- ⟦{似|に}る→似る：01159_niru⟧: to resemble (basic, general)
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}する→類似する：25547_ruijisuru⟧: to be similar (formal, academic)
